jei.barelyfunctionalcontraptions.info.ge:
The Mycelial Generator burns mushrooms and water to produce Forge Energy (FE). One generator produces %s FE/t times the fuel's energy multiplier.

Generators touching on any of their six faces form a network. Every running generator in a network is boosted: Network FE/t = Base x N x %s^(N-1), for up to %s connected generators. Energy is pushed into adjacent cables and machines automatically.
jei.barelyfunctionalcontraptions.info.wa: Water: a running generator uses %s mB every %s. The %s mB tank is filled with buckets (right-click or the bucket slot) or with fluid pipes.
jei.barelyfunctionalcontraptions.info.my: Mycelium: every %s of running time the generator tries to turn a dirt block with air above it, within %s blocks, into mycelium. The first attempt has a %s chance. Each unsuccessful attempt adds %s, up to %s, so after at most %s attempts a conversion is guaranteed. After a success the chance %s.
Mycelium spreading is disabled on this server.

jei.barelyfunctionalcontraptions.info.wr:
The Barely Functional Wrench links Mycelial Generators that are not touching.

Right-click a generator to select it, then right-click another generator to link the two. Shift + right-click a generator to remove all of its manual links. Shift + right-click the air to clear the selection.

Linked generators join one network exactly like touching ones. Every running generator in the network counts towards N in Network FE/t = Base x N x %s^(N-1), so linking distant generators boosts all of them. Links to generators in unloaded chunks are kept but only count while both are loaded.
On this server: up to %s blocks apart, at most %s links per generator, cross-dimension links %s, %s, %s.
links may not merge two existing networks
Each generator keeps its own mushrooms, water and energy unless the server enables resource sharing.
